results.title: A bound for $L(\sigma,\chi)$ near $1$
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $q\ge1$, let $\chi$ be a nonprincipal Dirichlet character modulo $q$, and let $L(s,\chi)$ be its $L$-function, the entire continuation of $\sum_{n\ge1}\chi(n)n^{-s}$. Put $M=\log q+3$. For every real $\sigma\ge1$, in particular $|L(1,\chi)|\le M$.
